name: Crucible Industries Ember-9 'Firefly'
description:
The Crucible Industries Ember-9 is a compact semi-automatic pistol chambered in 9x19mm with an integrated visible laser designator and weapon light in a single under-barrel unit. The laser and light activate simultaneously when the shooter's grip engages a pressure switch on the front strap, providing instant target illumination and designation in low-light conditions.

The Firefly is designed for the security professional who operates primarily in the dark — overnight building security, parking structure patrols, residential compound perimeters. The integrated light eliminates the need for a separate handheld flashlight, and the laser provides a visible aiming reference that works faster than traditional sights in the stress and disorientation of a sudden nocturnal encounter.

Crucible packages the Ember-9 with a quick-draw holster specifically molded for the light/laser unit and markets the complete system as a 'night-shift package.' The combination has become standard equipment for contract security firms operating the overnight shift in Mid-tier commercial districts, where the visible laser serves double duty as both aiming device and deterrent — most would-be intruders reconsider their plans when a red dot appears on their chest.
specifications:
caliber: 9x19mm
effective_range: 45 meters
rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic
magazine_capacity: 15 rounds
weight: 0.76 kg
light_output: 500 lumens
laser_wavelength: 635nm visible red
tactical_use: A compact duty pistol optimized for low-light operations. The integrated light and laser provide instant target identification and aiming capability in darkness. The grip-activated switch eliminates the need for manual activation under stress. Effective for security patrols and building clearing operations. The visible laser serves as both aiming aid and visible deterrent.
cultural_context: The Firefly has become synonymous with overnight security work in the Mids. The red laser dot is such a common sight in commercial district parking structures after dark that it has become its own form of visual shorthand — 'catching a firefly' means getting illuminated by a security guard's laser during after-hours trespassing.
story_hooks: Security footage shows a Firefly's laser tracking a target through a building — but the security guard assigned to that patrol was found unconscious in their vehicle. Someone else was using the weapon.
A modified Firefly with an infrared laser invisible to the naked eye is being used to designate targets for a sniper operating somewhere in the upper levels of a commercial district.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, purpose-built compact pistol with a pronounced undercarriage housing. The integrated light/laser module creates a distinctive bulbous profile beneath the slide, giving it an almost insectoid appearance—hence 'Firefly.' The overall silhouette is businesslike and modern, with clean lines and minimal ornamentation.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall length 180mm, slide height 125mm from frame to top of sight plane, width 35mm, barrel length 95mm, under-barrel module protrusion 45mm
physical_description.weight_description: Balanced and manageable at 0.76kg—heavy enough to absorb recoil but light enough for extended wear on a duty belt. The forward weight of the integrated module is noticeable but not unwieldy.
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade polymer composite frame with a steel reinforced slide and barrel. The under-barrel module is anodized aluminum with polymer bezels protecting the lens and emitter.
physical_description.finish: Matte black polymer frame with a brushed charcoal-gray metallic slide. The under-barrel module features a semi-gloss black finish with rubberized grip panels on the front strap.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray and tactical black with brushed steel accents on the slide serrations. The pressure-switch trim ring is anodized gunmetal.
physical_description.grip_texture: Stippled polymer front strap with aggressive checkering for positive purchase even in wet conditions. The wraparound grip panels are soft-touch rubberized with subtle ergonomic ridges.
distinctive_features: Integrated 500-lumen weapon light beneath the slide with protective polymer bezel
635nm visible red laser emitter mounted coaxially with the light
Recessed pressure switch on front strap with tactile positive detent
Machined witness holes on the slide for sight replacement
Aggressive slide serrations at rear for press-checks
Undercut trigger guard for high grip purchase
Minimal sight radius with low-profile combat sights as backup
Heat-dissipating vents along the module sides
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: CRUCIBLE INDUSTRIES stamped vertically on the left slide in sans-serif font. EMBER-9 FIREFLY etched below the ejection port. Serial number on right side of frame. Caliber marking (9x19mm) inside the trigger guard. CE compliance mark on the module bezel.
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-ready and well-maintained. Most examples show light holster wear on the module edges and faint scuff marks on the slide from regular duty carry. The lens and emitter remain clear and unobstructed. No corrosion on exposed metal surfaces—maintained to corporation standards.
